tools.name: get-timer-status
tools.title: Get Timer Status
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to check the current state of their timer, including whether it is running, paused, or stopped, and how much time has been tracked today.

tools.name: start-timer
tools.title: Start Timer
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to begin tracking time on a specific project. The user can optionally specify a start time in the past, otherwise it defaults to now.

tools.name: stop-timer
tools.title: Stop Timer
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to stop the currently active timer and complete the time tracking session. The user can optionally specify when the timer should be stopped.

tools.name: pause-timer
tools.title: Pause Timer
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to pause the timer to take a break. This temporarily stops time tracking while keeping the task active.

tools.name: resume-timer
tools.title: Resume Timer
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to resume time tracking after a break or pause. This restarts the timer from its paused state.

tools.name: list-projects
tools.title: List Projects
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see their projects, or to resolve a project name to the project ID that the timer and time logging tools need.

tools.name: list-tasks
tools.title: List Time Entries
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to review time entries for a day or date range, optionally narrowed to one project. Returns each entry plus the total tracked.

tools.name: log-time
tools.title: Log Time
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to record time for work they already finished, rather than running a timer.

tools.name: list-todos
tools.title: List Todos
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see open or completed todos, optionally narrowed to one project.

tools.name: close-todo
tools.title: Close Todo
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to mark a todo as done.

tools.name: get-team-status
tools.title: Get Team Status
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to know who on their team is currently tracking time and what they are working on.

tools.name: list-absences
tools.title: List Absences
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see holidays, sick leave, or other absences in their organization.

tools.name: search-projects
tools.title: Projects
tools.description: Find a Timesheet project to mention in AI Chat.

tools.name: search-todos
tools.title: Todos
tools.description: Find an open Timesheet todo to mention in AI Chat.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token (optional)
preferences.description: Leave empty to sign in with your Timesheet account. Set a token to skip the sign-in, for example on a shared or scripted setup.
